exposure: Length of stay in the hospital
cohort: 403 neonates admitted to neonatal intensive care units (NICUs)
finding: The rate of neonatal mortality was high (14.6%), and factors associated with neonatal mortality included lack of antenatal care, cesarean section delivery, length of stay in the hospital, low temperature at admission, and birth asphyxia.
mod_finding: Cesarean section delivery was significantly associated with neonatal mortality.
